map.Corsi 广度和数字广度有什么区别？: What is the difference between Corsi block span and digit span?
map.Corsi 木块敲击测试 - 在线工具: Corsi Block Tapping Test - Online Tool
map.Corsi 测视觉空间记忆（位置序列），数字广度测语音/言语记忆（数字序列），两: Corsi block tapping measures visual-spatial memory (a sequence of positions), while digit span measures verbal/auditory memory (a sequence of digits). They assess different pathways.
map.分心环境会明显下降，建议在安静处测: A distracting environment lowers the result noticeably, so measure it somewhere quiet
map.单次偏低未必异常，受疲劳与注意力影响；若持续明显偏低建议就医评估。: A single low reading is not necessarily abnormal, since fatigue and attention affect it; if it stays clearly low, get a medical evaluation.
map.单次结果有波动，可取多次平均: A single result fluctuates, so take the average of several runs
map.可设置起始长度与最大长度: You can set the starting length and the maximum length
map.在屏幕上依次点亮一组方块，你按相同顺序点击复述；序列长度逐轮增加，直到无法正确复: A group of blocks lights up in sequence on screen and you tap them back in the same order. The sequence grows each round until you can no longer reproduce it; the longest length you manage is your visual-spatial working memory span (Corsi span). It suits attention assessment, brain injury rehabilitation and everyday memory training.
map.实时反馈对错与当前最长序列: Real-time feedback on correctness and the current longest sequence
map.序列长度自适应递增，精准定位记忆上限: The sequence length increases adaptively to pinpoint your memory limit
map.康复随访：脑损伤或卒中后的记忆训练: Rehabilitation follow-up: memory training after brain injury or stroke
map.按顺序点击方块复述该序列: Tap the blocks in order to reproduce that sequence
map.日常训练：用递增难度锻炼短期记忆: Daily training: use increasing difficulty to exercise short-term memory
map.查看你的最大正确序列长度（Corsi 广度）: See your longest correct sequence length (Corsi span)
map.点击开始，记住第一组点亮的方块顺序: Click start and remember the order of the first group of blocks that light up
map.答对则下一轮序列加长，答错则结束: Correct answers lengthen the sequence for the next round, a wrong answer ends it
map.纯浏览器本地运行，数据不上传: Runs purely in the local browser, data is not uploaded
map.认知评估：快速了解视觉空间工作记忆水平: Cognitive assessment: a quick look at your visual-spatial working memory level
map.逆向广度更能反映中央执行功能: Backward span reflects central executive function better
map.逆向广度（可选）：按相反顺序复述，难度更高: Backward span (optional): reproduce the sequence in reverse order, which is harder
map.需要挑战时开启逆向模式重新测: Turn on reverse mode and test again when you want a challenge
map.顺向广度正常成人约 5~6 个，逆向约 4~5 个: Forward span is about 5-6 items in healthy adults and about 4-5 backward
map.顺向广度：按原顺序复述点亮的方块序列: Forward span: reproduce the lit block sequence in the original order
